title: Repeater Roundabout
subtitle: Get to know your local repeaters November 14th and 15th, 2026.

# About

The Repeater Roundabout is a weekend-long event held on many of your local repeaters. The goal is to meet new people and work repeaters you might not usually key up. It's also a great way to get started with ham radio contests for folk who are primarily repeater users. 

Previously, we made it into [QST Magazine](assets/RR.pdf). Light up the airwaves and make some noise on the great repeaters in Washington and Idaho ! Anyone with a ham radio license can participate. This is a friendly, collaborative event for all FM users on VHF and UHF. **New this year :** Echolink, Allstar and other Internet modes now count on repeaters that list their connection details on the [repeaters page](/repeaters) !


**The Repeater Roundabout will be held during the weekend of November 14th and 15th, 2026.**

> This page was last updated on Thursday November 26 at 17:54.

---


# Results

The contest is over ! Many thanks to those who participated; we hope you had fun. Check back next year for the next Repeater Roundabout !

Here are some stats on the contest, based on the logs received. These numbers are underestimates, because we are missing a good number of logs !

- Total number of contacts made : 967
- Number of unique operators contacted : 190
- Number of repeaters activated : 77
- Number of participants who submitted logs : 16

        color: #0f0;

    }

    .pew-play-btn {
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: #0f0;
        font-family: "SF Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
        font-size: 1.1em;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0 4px;
    }

    .pew-scrubber {
        width: 240px;
    }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
    const data = JSON.parse(atob(""));
    const map = L.map("pew-pew-map");
    L.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
    }).addTo(map);

    // Tooltips as text nodes, so callsigns from submitted logs are never parsed as HTML
    const text = s => document.createTextNode(s);

    // Bow each leg into an arc so legs between nearby points stay distinguishable
    function arc(a, b) {
        const mid = [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2 - (b[1] - a[1]) * 0.2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2 + (b[0] - a[0]) * 0.2];
        const pts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
            const t = i / 20, u = 1 - t;
            pts.push([u * u * a[0] + 2 * u * t * mid[0] + t * t * b[0], u * u * a[1] + 2 * u * t * mid[1] + t * t * b[1]]);
        }
        return pts;
    }

    const repeaters = {}, stations = {};
    for (const [rr, , lat, lon] of data.repeaters) repeaters[rr] = [lat, lon];
    for (const [call, lat, lon] of data.stations) stations[call] = [lat, lon];

    for (const [call, lat, lon, participant] of data.stations) {
        L.circleMarker([lat, lon], {
            radius: participant ? 5 : 3, color: participant ? "#c92a2a" : "#1c7ed6", fillOpacity: 0.9
        }).bindTooltip(text(call + (participant ? " (submitted a log)" : ""))).addTo(map);
    }
    for (const [, label, lat, lon] of data.repeaters) {
        L.circleMarker([lat, lon], { radius: 4, color: "#165a0a", fillOpacity: 1 }).bindTooltip(text(label)).addTo(map);
    }

    // Frame the repeaters; far-off Internet contacts would otherwise zoom out to the whole country
    map.fitBounds(data.repeaters.map(r => [r[2], r[3]]), { padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 12 });

    // Replay the contest: the virtual clock runs 48 contest-hours in `duration` real seconds (default ~2min).
    const totalMinutes = data.contest_minutes;
    const requested = Number(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("duration"));
    const duration = requested > 0 && isFinite(requested) ? requested : 120;
    const msPerMinute = duration * 1000 / totalMinutes;

    const eventsByMinute = new Map();
    for (const [call, rr, minute] of data.events) {
        if (!eventsByMinute.has(minute)) eventsByMinute.set(minute, []);
        eventsByMinute.get(minute).push([call, rr]);
    }

    // Dead air (no contacts) plays at a flat one-minute pace per idle stretch instead of
    // real time, so overnight gaps don't sit there at full pace. Active minutes keep msPerMinute pace.
    // minuteStart[m] is the cumulative wall-clock ms at which minute m begins.
    const minuteStart = new Array(totalMinutes + 1);
    minuteStart[0] = 0;
    for (let m = 0; m < totalMinutes;) {
        const active = eventsByMinute.has(m);
        let runEnd = m + 1;
        while (runEnd < totalMinutes && eventsByMinute.has(runEnd) === active) runEnd++;
        const runLength = runEnd - m;
        const runMs = active ? runLength * msPerMinute : msPerMinute;
        for (let i = 0; i < runLength; i++) minuteStart[m + i + 1] = minuteStart[m + i] + runMs / runLength;
        m = runEnd;
    }

    // minuteStart is monotonic but not evenly spaced, so find the current minute by binary search.
    function minuteAt(elapsed) {
        let lo = 0, hi = totalMinutes - 1;
        while (lo < hi) {
            const mid = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1;
            if (minuteStart[mid] <= elapsed) lo = mid; else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    // Respect reduced motion by skipping the fade instead of hiding the flash entirely.
    const reducedMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    function flash(call, rr) {
        if (!(call in stations) || !(rr in repeaters)) return;
        const line = L.polyline(arc(stations[call], repeaters[rr]), {
            className: "pew-flash", color: "#e8590c", weight: 2, opacity: 0.9
        }).addTo(map);
        const el = line.getElement();
        if (el && !reducedMotion) {
            el.style.transition = "opacity 100ms linear";
            requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => { el.style.opacity = 0; }));
        }
        setTimeout(() => map.removeLayer(line), 150);
    }

    const clock = L.control({ position: "bottomleft" });
    clock.onAdd = () => L.DomUtil.create("div", "pew-clock leaflet-bar");
    clock.addTo(map);
    const clockEl = document.querySelector(".pew-clock");

    const controls = L.control({ position: "bottomright" });
    controls.onAdd = () => {
        const container = L.DomUtil.create("div", "pew-controls leaflet-bar");
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("button", "pew-play-btn", container);
        btn.type = "button";
        const range = L.DomUtil.create("input", "pew-scrubber", container);
        range.type = "range";
        range.min = 0;
        range.max = totalMinutes - 1;
        range.step = 1;
        range.value = 0;
        range.setAttribute("aria-label", "Seek contest replay");
        // Prevent dragging the slider or clicking the button from panning/zooming the map underneath.
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(container);
        L.DomEvent.disableScrollPropagation(container);
        return container;
    };
    controls.addTo(map);
    const playBtn = document.querySelector(".pew-play-btn");
    const range = document.querySelector(".pew-scrubber");

    function formatClock(minute) {
        const day = minute < 1440 ? 14 : 15;
        const h = String(Math.floor((minute % 1440) / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
        const m = String(minute % 60).padStart(2, "0");
        return `Nov ${day}, ${h}:${m}`;
    }

    // playing/frozenElapsed track the pause state explicitly so resume continues from
    // where it left off instead of jumping ahead by however long the tab sat paused.
    let playing = true, startTime = null, frozenElapsed = 0, lastMinute = -1, rafId = null, dragging = false;

    function setPlayButton() {
        playBtn.textContent = playing ? "⏸" : "▶";
        playBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", playing ? "Pause replay" : "Play replay");
    }
    setPlayButton();

    function tick(now) {
        if (startTime === null) startTime = now;
        const elapsed = now - startTime;
        const minute = minuteAt(elapsed);
        for (let m = lastMinute + 1; m <= minute; m++) {
            for (const [call, rr] of eventsByMinute.get(m) || []) flash(call, rr);
        }
        lastMinute = minute;
        clockEl.textContent = formatClock(minute);
        if (!dragging) range.value = minute;
        if (minute >= totalMinutes - 1) {
            // Loop back to the start instead of stopping dead; next tick's for-loop above
            // will fire minute 0's events exactly once since lastMinute resets to -1.
            lastMinute = -1;
            startTime = now;
            frozenElapsed = 0;
            range.value = 0;
            clockEl.textContent = formatClock(0);
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    function play() {
        if (playing) return;
        playing = true;
        startTime = performance.now() - frozenElapsed;
        setPlayButton();
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }

    function pause() {
        if (!playing) return;
        playing = false;
        if (rafId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
        frozenElapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
        setPlayButton();
    }

    // Seeking jumps lastMinute straight to the target minute rather than replaying every
    // flash in between, which would flood the map across a 48-hour contest's worth of contacts.
    function seekTo(minute) {
        minute = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalMinutes - 1, minute));
        lastMinute = minute;
        frozenElapsed = minuteStart[minute];
        if (playing) startTime = performance.now() - frozenElapsed;
        clockEl.textContent = formatClock(minute);
    }

    playBtn.addEventListener("click", () => { if (playing) pause(); else play(); });
    range.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => { dragging = true; });
    range.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { dragging = false; });
    range.addEventListener("input", () => seekTo(Number(range.value)));

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
})();
</script>
